segments.text: Warning: the Swift is still the hatchback king, and if you're not driving one, you're probably driving a mess
Packing 85 kW of power, this car isn't slow, but let's be real, it's not trying to win any drag races
The real hero here is the 160 N⋅m of torque - it's like having a get-out-of-jail-free card for all your driving mishaps
Under the hood, you'll find a humble 1.3-liter engine, which is probably why it still manages to squeeze out 26.4 km/L - because who doesn't love saving money on fuel?

For a steal, you can get the ZXi variant, loaded with goodies like a 9-inch touchscreen with wireless Android Auto, cruise control, 6 airbags, LED headlamps, and alloy wheels - all for an estimated price that's harder to resist than a pizza
But let's get real, if you're still cruising around in a Swift from the ancient times, it's time to level up - your friends are low-key judging you, and honestly, so are we
So, are you still team Swift, or have you joined the dark side? Let us know in the comments, and don't forget to follow for more juicy car content!
